text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test-and-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Type check
        run: pnpm typecheck

      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Format check
        run: pnpm format --check

      - name: Run tests with coverage
        run: pnpm test:coverage

      - name: Check coverage thresholds
        run: |
          # Verify coverage meets minimum threshold
          COVERAGE=$(pnpm test:coverage --reporter=text | grep "All files" | awk '{print $4}' | sed 's/%//')
          if (( $(echo "$COVERAGE < 50" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "Coverage is below 50%: $COVERAGE%"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Coverage is $COVERAGE%, which meets the 50% threshold"

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          file: ./coverage/lcov.info
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella
```
